_about: Labelled cases for measuring FlowMancer's accuracy. Each case lists only what a correct answer must get right. knowledge.name: Refund policy
knowledge.text: Refund policy: customers can get a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days. After 30 days we offer account credit instead of a refund.

knowledge.name: Pricing
knowledge.text: Pricing: Starter is $29 per user per month. Pro is $59 per user per month. Teams of 50 or more seats get a 15% volume discount. Annual billing saves 2 months.

knowledge.name: Support hours
knowledge.text: Support hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm IST. Production outages are handled 24/7 by the on-call engineer.
